items.prompt: Cinematic anime film still, semi-realistic painted anime art like a Makoto Shinkai movie, detailed hand-painted lighting, soft depth of field, film grain. Upper body, facing the viewer, gentle tired expression, standing outside a hospital at night in light rain, cold blue light with a warm rim light.
